nexora-nvidia-deep-research.description: NEXORA's authenticated Cloudflare MCP bridge to the NVIDIA Deep Research async-job API. Enable only after a real NVIDIA research backend is deployed and DEEP_RESEARCHER_URL plus the matching Cloudflare secrets are configured.

nexora-cloudflare-research.description: Authenticated Cloudflare MCP bridge to NEXORA's currently deployed Atlas multi-agent research workflow. It returns an answer and source metadata; it is distinct from the separate NVIDIA Deep Researcher Python job service.
